name: Professional services trial sequences (accounting, bookkeeping, legal, insurance, consulting, staffing)
source: Copy v2 (docs/research/v2-leads-copy.md): plain text, no links in email 1, one reply CTA, four touches. No claim about the client beyond {oneLiner} / {proof}; no result promised.

problem-first.label: Problem first
problem-first.why: The owner doing the paperwork at night is a pain almost every small business recognises; one line on the offer, then an easy question.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, one more thought.

The real cost is rarely the fee. It is the hours you spend on it instead of on running {Company}.

Worth a short call to see if {ClientCompany} could take some of that off your plate?

touches.subject: busy season
touches.body:
{FirstName}, a different angle.

Most {ICP} only look for help with {niche} when something goes wrong. It is easier to set up before the busy season.

Would a 15-minute call next week be useful?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply here is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

question-led.label: Question led
question-led.why: Asks who handles the work today; in-house or outside, the answer is easy to write back.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, asking because the answer tells me quickly whether this is worth your time.

If an outside firm is doing well by you, no need to change. If it sits with you or a busy staff member, {ClientCompany} can take it on.

Which is it at {Company}?

touches.subject: question for {Company}
touches.body:
{FirstName}, one practical check.

It is worth knowing how many hours a month {niche} takes you. For many {ICP}, the honest number is higher than they think.

Want {ClientCompany} to help you work it out?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply here is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?

quick-idea.label: Quick idea
quick-idea.why: Offers a short review of how the work is handled today; the ask is to send what it covers.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, a review like that is quick to do and easy to put off.

{ClientCompany} can run it with you at a time that suits.

Would that be useful for {Company}?

touches.subject: busy season
touches.body:
{FirstName}, a second idea.

The weeks before the busy season are the easiest time to hand {niche} over, while nothing is pressing.

Open to a 15-minute call to see if that fits {Company}?

{FirstName}, this is my last note so your inbox stays clear.

If {niche} comes up at {Company} later, a one-line reply here is all it takes.

Should I close the file for now?
